description:
Key a solid background out of a generated image to true RGBA transparency (flood-fill + enclosed-region sweep + tight crop) and upload the result. Runs server-side (Python + Pillow). If the generator produced a tinted/muted green instead of pure #00FF00, it auto-recovers by re-keying in green-dominance mode (safe for art with no bright-green/lime elements). Returns a NEW image_uuid plus keying_mode.

[#3cd7e7]

background_mode.description: How to detect the background. auto (default): box-key a pure-green screen, else auto-recover in dominance mode for a tinted/muted green. box: strict pure-#00FF00 keying (best for colorful designs with warm/lime elements). dominance: green-dominance keying, robust to tinted green screens (safe when the design has no bright-green/lime elements).

force.description: Bypass the pure-green safety check and box-key anyway. Use only when you have visually confirmed the palette has no colors near the green background.

image_url.description: The image URL, if known (else resolved from the uuid).

name: process_transparency
